query: How smoothly does the Samsung Galaxy A51 run everyday apps, and what lag or freezing do owners experience?
search_text: How smoothly does the run everyday apps, and what lag or freezing do owners experience?

rows.text: Lags a LOT. It lags a lot so i need to restart it every day, and even then its still laggy... I've had it for only 5 months
Smooth. I love it, Excellent camera quality, full 2160p60 UHD screen resolution, and amazingly day and smooth gameplay on large games like: PUBG, Life After.

Good for gaming. This phone works very well and has next to no lag in most everything it does. The only lag I have seen was with networks which cannot be attributed to the phone. Nice vibrant display and very quick, especially for the price.

The camera hardware is great, the software-not so much. Transitioning between lenses is slow and cumbersome, and loading the camera app takes long enough that whatever I want to take a picture of is often gone by the time I even get to the right screen. Honestly, if they'd put less money toward camera hardware that isn't really necessary (cough depth sensor and macro lens), and the screen, and more toward the processor, ram, and overall experience, this would be a fantastic phone for the price. If the software ran smoothly for the most part it would be acceptable even if it was slow. It is, after all, a midrange device. But it does not run smoothly or quickly. You have to wait for everything to happen, if it ever does, and re-try things because of glitches and crashes.
Awsome Samsung phone. Great phone runs great does everything I need no lagging good speed I highly recommend this phone
Much faster than my S7. I should have said it up when I wasn't tired and what if not allowed the add-on apps

Degrades very fast, or was already planned to fail. The over look of the phone is great. However beware the constant slowness of the phone. I usually use the Google pixel 3 xl . I've had this phone for less then two weeks now, and without very much use or work. It has been slowing down on me quiet severely. With it being 2020 and having lag issues is quiet frustrating. If I had a suggestion I would buy a google a xl. The speed is very constant , and for the near the same price however they recently increased the price by 100 to 360, however it is a great buget phone that works well.

And the battery life is very good unless you are doing something that keeps the screen active constantly, like playing a game a watching videos. The processor and memory in this phone leave a lot to be desired, though, and though I knew this phone wouldn't be as speedy as my S10 I didn't expect to be reminded of my first smart phone in terms of responsiveness. For example, on my S10 when I opened my music app the last song played displayed immediately. On the A51, I open the app and have to wait for 5 or 6 seconds before I can do anything. I notice similar sluggishness when using a food app and when using the camera. Basically, everything is slow on this device.
Love this phone. Been using for a month now smooth run .

Good buy for the money.. Bought this phone because my Samsung S7 was starting to have a lot of problems. Used smart switch to transfer data to the A51 and all my apps worked except the voice messaging. I get a notification of voice mail and have to input my code but that is no real problem. I like the fell of the phone, good clarity on the microphone and the color is good. All my apps run very fast. very pleased with the A51.

Good physical condition, not so good with my network.. The phone was in good condition physically but runs extremely slow and sometimes I don't receive calls or messages. My network works fine in other devices. Product just recently started glitching during videos.

Good phone, not for me. There is nothing particularly bad about this phone, but after several years of getting use to Motorola's UI, switching to Samsung felt a bit disorientating. Samsung Daily is an abysmal alternative to Google Feed that way more complex than it needs to be. The settings menu runs surprisingly slow, sometimes taking about 5 seconds or more to load up. Trying to orientate apps and widgets felt way more complicated than on my old phone. I will be returning it and swapping back over to Motorola. If you are already use to Samsung's UI, this phone is honestly a good model. The camera is great, it has a great amount of storage space, and it has some considerable hardware for a budget phone.

Great Phone. The phone is great. The phone is great! It has a lot of storage capacity and many cool features. Much of the data from my LG were transferred successfully since I had it backed up to Google. Because data from other apps weren't transferrable (i.e. Quick Notes to Samsung Notes), I found a way to do so via Google Docs. I didn't care for many of the unnecessary apps (games), which were uninstalled once I had the phone up and running. The only thing I'm trying to figure out now is how I can best utilize my Google features versus those offered by the Samsung apps. For many, it may not be appealing purchasing a locked phone (for Tracfone sad but I've been using Tracfone for several years, and appreciate the flexibility offered in its plans... and the talk, text, and data is quite sufficient.

Just activated to replace my Samsung A03s on Cricket Wireless! Loving it!. So far so good! I needed a decent phone that worked on Cricket Wireless, a GSM carrier. And almost everyone phone I saw said it works on all CMDA and some GSM carriers... This phone was more specific on it's details and said it worked with GSM. And it did with no issues. The phone may be a few year old model but it's faster than my work A32 5G and the Samsung A03s I replaced is the Summer sunshine vs Winter freeze! It soo smooth with graphics! A++++++

Unlucky i guess. Had this phone for over a year. Was slow since I got it couldn't handle doing much and just got slower over time. 4gb ram is not enough, currently it can handle one app open and I've cleared storage only have important apps downloaded because if i save/download more the phone says nope. Maybe i got unlucky? Other reviews seem good or do you guys just like slow phones? Go with 6gb ram or higher
No lagging snaps. Great pictures... the pixels are great ... and the flash timing is amazing

Overall an amazing phone! The camera is stellar and it runs fast. I've had the phone for around a month now. I usually buy midrange phone from the store and call it a day. This time, I wanted a decent camera for all the pictures I take while out hiking or seeing family and friends. Capture the memories, you know? So anyway, here are my pros and cons. PROS: Phone speed Camera quality Screen size Simple set-up Cons: Sometimes the fingerprint scanner can be testy On the rare occasion it has a hard time finding a network connection. One thing to note when I first got the phone, taking into consideration how it's an unlocked former AT&T phone and I have t-mobile, it was difficult getting it to find any network at all. I had to find a troubleshooting guide off of t-mobile's support website to figure it out.

Nice phone. Works as expected plugged Tracfone SIM in CELL service works immediately ( over verizon CDMA ) - ran through settings, configured Samsung pay also added Google pay - Samsung transfer app moved most apps and files settings - ready to roll still had to reinstall and configure a few apps. Found a good video on UTube ( a51 beast mode ) that shows some tweaks to improve performance some - overall general phone responsiveness is improved - seems to help and a good tip on FP reader - register same finger three times !

Good for 1 year. Loved this phone when I first got it, Jan of 2021. By summer it was already running slower and within the year the battery wasn't even lasting 8 hours. Ok, if you're into getting a new phone every year. I

Screen constantly freezes .. As soon as it was activated the screen began to freeze up every few minutes. Will not unfreeze unless you push lock button and start unlocking screen again. Big disappointment. And then I see that another store has brand new ones at a cheaper price. Bummer.
